periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, tilted approximately 45 degrees toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high aspect ratio, height significantly exceeding width in the lateral projection.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower pole extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Moderately flat U-shape with a slight posterior indentation along the midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band, accounting for approximately 30% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate separation, distance between medial ear bases is roughly equivalent to a single pinna width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded apex without visible flattening or notches.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-orange chromic shift or staining on the fur of the posterior haunches and tail region.
